intro: A Simple Sigil is a modest training token presented to novice night elf warriors in Shadowglen. Carried as a summons from the warrior trainer Alyissia, it marks a young fighter's formal introduction into the martial defense of Teldrassil.

p: Within the sheltered boughs of Shadowglen, young night elves are guided by Conservator Ilthalaine to find their calling. For fledgling warriors, Ilthalaine delivers a Simple Sigil sent by a runner from the warrior trainer Alyissia. Bearing an inscription that directs the recruit to report for instruction, this token represents the start of disciplined martial training amidst troubling times for the World Tree.

When brought to Alyissia, the sigil opens a dialogue on the pressing state of the kaldorei. The recent growth of Teldrassil, the creeping corruption tainting forest beasts, and the rediscovery of distant lands like Feralas have stretched night elven protectors thin. The sigil is not an artifact of power, but a practical credential welcoming the recruit into the fold of guardians tasked with shielding their people from emerging threats.
